title: Twelve Hours on a Wall
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：adventure　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 adventure 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my uncle went on one ① adventure, meaning nine days on the coast, and came back with twelve stories and one photograph, and never went again. He said an adventure should come early in a life, because afterwards you only go on holidays, and holidays are the same thing with the danger taken out; an adventure, he said, is a holiday that has not been decided yet.

The ② adventure story he told me, the one about the boat and the twelve men, was the same one he had been told in 1931, and I found that out in 1988 and said nothing. There was ③ a spirit of adventure in our house and nowhere else in the street, my mother said, and she meant it as a complaint; adventure, she said, is what people call it when it happens to somebody else.

The ④ adventure, meaning the thing itself and not the story, lasted nine days and included twelve hours on a wall waiting for a tide, which is the part he never told. He called the waiting ⑤ an adventure in patience, and my grandmother said an adventure you can call something else is not one.

In 1971 he took me to a travel agency and asked for ⑥ an adventure holiday, which was a new word then, and the woman at the desk said she had never heard it and wrote down 'coast'. We went to the same coast and it rained for nine days, and he said the ⑦ adventure had been in the asking and not in the going, and that every adventure is nine-tenths asking.

The ⑧ adventure I would go on, if it were 1971 again, is the nine days and the twelve hours on the wall, in the rain, with a man who had been told one story in 1931 and had kept it for fifty-seven years. There was ⑨ no adventure left in him by 1984, he said, and he meant the spirit and not the miles; the ⑩ adventure of asking a woman at a desk for something she has never heard of is the only one I have ever managed myself.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 冒险（的经历）；奇遇
B. n. 冒险精神；冒险的刺激
C. n. 不寻常的经历；离奇的遭遇
E. 固定搭配：an adventure story / film 冒险故事／冒险片
F. 固定搭配：a spirit of adventure 冒险精神
G. 固定搭配：go on an adventure 去冒险；踏上探险之旅
H. 固定搭配：an adventure in ... 在……方面的一次尝试／冒险

items.q: The adventure story he told me
a spirit of adventure in our house
The adventure, meaning the thing itself
the adventure had been in the asking
The adventure I would go on
There was no adventure left in him
the adventure of asking a woman

answers.why: adventure 意为“冒险的经历、奇遇”，1962 年叔叔经历了唯一一次冒险——去海边待了九天。
an adventure story 意为“冒险故事”，他讲给我听的那个小船与十二个人的故事，其实是 1931 年别人讲给他的。
a spirit of adventure 意为“冒险精神”，母亲说我们家有这种精神，街上别的人家都没有。
adventure 意为“冒险经历”，真正那次冒险历时九天，其中包括在墙上等潮水的十二个小时。
an adventure in ... 意为“在……方面的一次尝试”，他把等潮水称为一次关于耐心的尝试。
adventure 作定语，意为“冒险的、探险的”，1971 年他去旅行社要订一次“冒险假日”，那在当时还是新词。
adventure 意为“不寻常的经历”，他说那次不寻常的遭遇在“问”而不在“去”。
go on an adventure 意为“去冒险、踏上探险之旅”，若回到 1971 年，我愿意再去的就是那九天。
adventure 意为“冒险精神”，他说到 1984 年他身上已没有冒险精神了，指的是精神而非里程。
adventure 意为“不寻常的经历”，向柜台后的女人要一样她从没听说过的东西，是我自己唯一做到过的一次。
